data.body: **[P1] Preserve fatal errors wrapped by `ExecutionException`.** `ExceptionHelper.unwrapCompletableFuture` only removes `CompletionException`, so a handler failure such as `CompletionException(new ExecutionException(fatal))` reaches this branch as an `ExecutionException`. The SDK then reports `FAILED` and returns a normal durable failure; the same incomplete unwrapping at the worker boundary lets that worker survive. Use a shared recursive helper that removes both wrapper types here, in `supplyAsync`, and during result delivery, and add handler/result-delivery regression tests for this nesting.
